summary: Correction to the escalation trigger note (#6896): a rollback to a release before the escalation clocks grows local_escalation_pending_v2 by one row per claim, and the next upgrade processes them in its first write

replay.detail: No replay. After a rollback to a release before #6733, the v2 escalation triggers still queue one local_escalation_pending_v2 row per claim and nothing drains them; the first write or open after upgrading again processes the backlog in one transaction, about 50 us a row (roughly 5 s per day of rollback on a busy member). Pacing it is tracked in #6934.

downtime.detail: Only after a rollback: the first write after upgrading again holds the writer while it processes the pending_v2 backlog, roughly 5 s per day of rollback.

recovery.detail: Rollback stays supported; this only states its cost on the way back.
